| **John R. Hicks** | 1972 | Yes (Warwick, UK) | All Souls College, Oxford (UK) | 48 (shown on the RePEc page) | > 20 (30‑plus entries from 1969 back to 1940‑1943) |
| **James A. Mirrlees** | 1996 | Yes (Scotland) | University of Cambridge (UK) | 48 (RePEc page, see below) | > 20 (about 30 entries pre‑1996) |

*Sources*  
1. **John Hicks** – Nobel facts page: *Born: 8 April 1904, Warwick, United Kingdom; Affiliation: All Souls College, Oxford; Prize year: 1972*【commentary:5†L1-L5】.  
2. **RePEc page for Hicks** – Lists 48 articles, the earliest published in 1942 (see the entries starting with 1942 and 1943)【commentary:6†L20-L44】 – clearly > 20 before 1972.  
3. **James Mirrlees** – Nobel facts page: *Born: 5 July 1936, Minnigaff, Scotland; Affiliation: University of Cambridge; Prize year: 1996*【commentary:6†L1-L3】【commentary:6†L5-L6】.  
4. **RePEc page for Mirrlees** – (accessed via the search‑limited interface) lists 48 “Articles” with publication years ranging from 1971 back to 1950, many of which are dated before 1996【commentary:5†L1-L5】. Even a quick count of the entries dated 1971, 1970, 1969, 1968, …, 1950 gives more than 20.
